scenes.summary: Rufus argued that keeping the family inside was not kidnapping and lured Lena back with fourteen million dollars hidden upstairs that would get him out of debt. They split up to grab the girl and the woman.

beats.text: Rufus reveals the prize: fourteen million dollars hidden upstairs, enough to clear Lena's debts
The burglars split up to seize the woman and the girl

humor.joke: 'You can't kidnap somebody in their own house' / 'third-generation idiot'

scenes.summary: Bram saw the intruders on the monitors, woke Hollis and they raced for the panic room as the burglars closed in, sealing the door just in time. The room's phone was dead because Bram had never connected it.

beats.text: Bram spots the intruders, grabs Hollis and they barely make it into the panic room
The panic room's separate phone line was never connected — they cannot call for help

moments.what: the race into the panic room

scenes.summary: Inside, Bram anxiously checked whether Hollis felt shaky or chilled, hinting at a medical condition.

beats.text: Bram checks Hollis for shakiness and chills — a hidden medical condition is planted

scenes.summary: Over the intercom the burglars told them to leave; Bram bluffed that police were coming. A sign was held up: what they wanted was inside the room. Coached by Hollis, Bram shouted at them to get out of her house.

beats.text: The burglars reveal that what they want is inside the panic room itself
Bram bluffs about the police and, coached by Hollis, defiantly refuses to come out

humor.joke: daughter coaches mom to swear: 'Say fuck.'

moments.what: 'Get the fuck out of my house!'

scenes.summary: The burglars bickered; Lena, who spent ten years building such rooms for a living, said nobody can get in, so the woman must be forced out. They decided to seal the house so the family could not escape.

beats.text: Lena turns out to be a builder of panic rooms who knows they cannot break in, so they must force the family out
They seal the house and refuse to let Milo hover with his gun

humor.joke: Milo laughs at God's sense of irony

scenes.summary: Bram began panicking in the small space; Hollis distracted her with a joke. When the intruders sealed them in, Bram lost it and Hollis screamed at her to stay present until she recovered.

beats.text: Claustrophobic Bram has a panic attack; Hollis pulls her back

humor.joke: 'Why did the chicken cross the road? To prove he wasn't chicken.'

moments.what: Hollis screams her mother out of a panic attack

scenes.summary: Rufus pumped gas into the room's vents to drive them out; Lena protested they would die and could not get in if the pair passed out. Rufus raged that he was coming in.

beats.text: Rufus pumps gas into the room to force them out, over Lena's objections

humor.joke: 'how are we supposed to get into the room if they pass out?' 'Oh.'

moments.what: gas fills the room, they cough

scenes.summary: Bram flashed SOS in Morse code at a neighbor, who ignored it. Meanwhile Rufus and Lena argued over splitting the fourteen million.

Rufus and Lena quarrel over shares of the money

story_so_far: Newly separated Bram and her daughter Hollis move into a brownstone with a steel panic room. On the first night, three burglars — planner Rufus, panic-room builder Lena, and armed gambler Milo — break in for fourteen million dollars hidden inside the panic room. Bram and Hollis make it into the room, but its phone was never connected. The burglars seal the house and pump gas into the vents; Hollis talks her claustrophobic mother through a panic attack, Bram's SOS to a neighbor is ignored, and the thieves start fighting over shares. Hollis seems to have a medical condition.
